diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index a2c7a7d..41f419d 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -3,3 +3,5 @@
 A tiny package that builds a greeting.
 
     python3 -c "from greet.core import build_greeting; print(build_greeting('Ada'))"
+
+Names are automatically capitalised in the greeting, so `build_greeting('ada')` returns `Hallo, Ada!`.

diff --git a/greet/core.py b/greet/core.py
index 503aa34..906a244 100644
--- a/greet/core.py
+++ b/greet/core.py
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@
 
 
 def build_greeting(name: str) -> str:
-    """Return the greeting for NAME."""
-    return f"Hallo, {name.strip()}!"
+    """Return the greeting for NAME, with the name title-cased."""
+    return f"Hallo, {name.strip().title()}!"

diff --git a/tests/test_greet.py b/tests/test_greet.py
index 1766d41..23ff783 100644
--- a/tests/test_greet.py
+++ b/tests/test_greet.py
@@ -10,6 +10,28 @@ def test_greeting_trims_spaces():
     assert build_greeting("  Ada ") == "Hallo, Ada!"
 
 
+def test_greeting_capitalises_a_lowercase_name():
+    assert build_greeting("alice") == "Hallo, Alice!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_title_cases_an_uppercase_name():
+    assert build_greeting("ALICE") == "Hallo, Alice!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_keeps_an_already_capitalised_name():
+    assert build_greeting("Alice") == "Hallo, Alice!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_title_cases_a_mixed_case_name():
+    assert build_greeting("aLiCe") == "Hallo, Alice!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_leaves_the_input_unchanged():
+    name = "aLiCe"
+    build_greeting(name)
+    assert name == "aLiCe"
+
+
 def test_cli_prints_the_greeting(capsys):
     assert main(["Ada"]) == 0
     assert capsys.readouterr().out == "Hallo, Ada!\n"
